title: A Gateway Drops Fifty Thousand Connections
description: A gateway fails and 50,000 clients immediately reconnect in lockstep, overloading healthy gateways. What recovery behavior reduces the next surge without abandoning delivery?

options.text: Reconnect continuously with zero delay until a socket opens.
options.explanation: Immediate synchronized attempts keep overloading recovery capacity.

options.text: Use capped exponential backoff with jitter and resume from each client's sequence cursor.
options.explanation: Jitter spreads reconnects over time; durable sequence-based catch-up recovers missed messages once connected. Planned deploys should also drain gracefully.

options.text: Discard every client's cursor to avoid replay work.
options.explanation: That removes the catch-up boundary and can lose messages or force a more expensive full sync.

options.text: Broadcast every live message to every gateway.
options.explanation: Broadcasting increases server work and cannot deliver to disconnected clients.
